content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_AND_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The term of the Lease shall commence on April 1, 2024, and end on March 31, 2029.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_RENT
content_blocks.text: Monthly rent for the Premises shall be $3,500, payable on the first day of each month.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._USE_OF_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall use the Premises exclusively for office space as per the attached floor plan.
